from pathlib import Path
import glob, re

inputs_dir = Path('/inputs')
work_file = Path('/work/README.md')
source_readme = inputs_dir / 'README.md'

# Read prefix bytes exactly
prefix = source_readme.read_bytes()

# Discover matching files in /inputs with glob *-*.md (files only), sorted by basename lexicographically
matches = [Path(p) for p in glob.glob('/inputs/*-*.md') if Path(p).is_file()]
matches.sort(key=lambda p: p.name)

rows = []
for p in matches:
    text = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    title = None
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if line.startswith('# '):
            title = line[2:].strip()
            break
    if title is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f'No level-one heading found in {p}')
    name = p.name
    rows.append(f'| [{name}](../inputs/{name}) | .md | {title} |')

# Build suffix exactly
lines = [
    '',
    '## Reference index',
    '',
    '| File | Type | Description |',
    '| --- | --- | --- |',
    *rows,
]
suffix = '\n'.join(lines) + '\n'

# Write output as UTF-8 with exact prefix bytes
work_file.write_bytes(prefix + suffix.encode('utf-8'))

# Validation checks
out = work_file.read_bytes()
assert out.startswith(prefix)
# Ensure last byte newline
assert out.endswith(b'\n')

# report discovered files for audit
print('written', work_file)
print('matches:', [p.name for p in matches])
